package.name: sam_target_inspection
package.description:
Adaptive close inspection of a proud seabed target: a side-scan target detector, a forward-looking-sonar proud-object detector, the ledger that associates their candidates, the inspection planner that answers "what next", and the capture recorder.
Sibling of `sam_farm_inspection` and built to the same discipline: pure-python cores that are driven exhaustively off-vehicle, ROS shells that only subscribe, convert, publish and report their own health. Detection runs on INTENSITIES and POINTS, never on the simulator's material labels (SETTLED §3k) — labels appear in tests only.
It holds NO action client and writes NO actuator. The planner is a setpoint SOURCE (ADR-004, invariant 12): it answers what the next sub-goal is, and the behaviour tree streams that answer through the ONE existing `auv_depth_move_to` client.
Nothing in this package has been flown. Strategy: data-cube/docs/2026-09-09-asko-adaptive-close-inspection-strategy.md
